prompt_en: Create a photorealistic high-fashion location editorial on the rain-darkened banked rooftop test track of the former Fiat Lingotto factory in Turin. One unmistakably adult woman in her early thirties sprints along the banked curve while unwinding a scarlet windsock from a chrome survey reel; the fabric catches the crosswind in a sweeping arc, her leading foot lands on reflective asphalt, one hand braces the reel at her hip, and droplets trace the taut line. Frame her as a rear-three-quarter full figure, with the entire body, opening, closure, visible front-side silhouette, reel, and sprinting action readable together. She wears a non-explicit revealing-fashion ensemble realized as a structured one-piece dress: a bounded oval upper-back opening is enclosed by continuous finished fabric edges at both shoulders, both side seams, and the waist. A centered metal neck clasp plus a narrow horizontal opaque fabric bridge visibly secure the opening during motion. Dense opaque front and side panels visibly cover the breasts and pelvis, and the three-quarter torso angle keeps that stable front-side coverage inspectable. The exposed skin inside the finished oval opening itself carries the open-back topology; swept-up hair clears every edge, directional rooftop light and soft side fill reveal the boundary, and the garment remains a single closed-front dress in solid nontransparent fabric. Preserve the monumental concrete helix, guardrails, rain reflections, Turin roofs, distant mountain haze, natural adult skin texture, wet footprints, wind-loaded cloth, and crisp industrial detail. Image 1 serves only as general visible appearance guidance for the adult subject's face, hair, and complexion; create an original adult editorial character with independently authored body, garment, pose, action, and setting.
